units.sourceHTML: 7.4 Rename Files to Lower Case

units.text: This is a pretty strange use of ⟦0⟧. We transform text, and transform it to be shell commands, then just feed them to shell. Don’t worry, even worse hacks are done when using ⟦1⟧; I have seen a script converting the output of ⟦2⟧ into a ⟦3⟧ program!
units.sourceHTML: This is a pretty strange use of sed. We transform text, and transform it to be shell commands, then just feed them to shell. Don’t worry, even worse hacks are done when using sed; I have seen a script converting the output of date into a bc program!

units.text: The main body of this is the ⟦0⟧ script, which remaps the name from lower to upper (or vice-versa) and even checks out if the remapped name is the same as the original name. Note how the script is parameterized using shell variables and proper quoting.
